items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee Helen Humes does not speak about Bobby Plater; the mention is made solely by the Interviewer.

ctx.x: Yeah, and you know, she don't want nobody to say anything to Basie or get close to him so I mean, I'm not trying to make no impression with nobody.

Well I was talking to Bobby Plater, and you know, I was really moved because he said, Basie is just so gutsy, it's so wonderful what he's doing. Bobby told me they just had four weeks in Europe, you know. This is before Basie got that little car. And he either was in a wheel chair or had to be carried. And you know how horrible for him it must have been. And Bobby said, you know, and Catherine told me too, she said that they come from the airport and maybe you want to go to the rest room, you got to wait until…
